_field_glossary.status: reported = the item's event was found in the day's material; not = checked, nothing found; unclear = ambiguous, a human should look
_field_glossary.side: break = if it happened, it weakens/breaks the thesis; confirm = if it happened, it supports the thesis
_field_glossary.verified: true only when code found the quoted text in the named source (>= 8 words, whitespace-insensitive). Unverified quotes must be visibly marked as unverified.
_field_glossary.followup_status: ok | reanalysis_queued | break_condition_met | unknown (unknown = follow-up data missing/unreadable/older than 36 hours: fail closed)
_field_glossary.buy_paused: true = no NEW buys while something is pending against the verdict; null = unknown (follow-up data stale) — treat as paused. Never sells anything.
_field_glossary.holding_state: own = actionable undervalued; do_not_own = actionable hold/overvalued or a substantive gate reason; unusable = a process failure (verdict could not be used) — a held name is carried on its last good verdict for at most 2 failures / 21 days
_field_glossary.thesis_status: intact | breached | unknown (unknown = no checkable rule, or not enough data)
